## What

Which library/component this touches, and what changed.

## Why

The problem this solves, or the issue it fixes (`Fixes #`).

## How

Brief note on approach — only if non-obvious from the diff.

## Testing

- [ ] `dotnet build` clean for the affected library/libraries
- [ ] `dotnet test` clean for the affected library/libraries
- [ ] Tried the change in a demo host (`/playground/<name>`), if visual/interactive

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated for the behavior change
- [ ] `README.md` updated if this changes usage (params, examples)
- [ ] `DEVELOPMENT.md` updated if this changes internal design/rationale
